question: Should OpenClaw bundle this Vault exec SecretRef provider and approve the dependency graph/trust model once the mechanical CI blockers are fixed?
rationale: The code path passes Vault credential material into a bundled exec resolver and adds package/lockfile surface, so automation can repair the CI blockers but cannot own the product/security acceptance decision.

options.title: Approve bundled Vault after fixes
options.body: Keep the PR as the bundled reference implementation, require the three mechanical fixes, then have maintainer/security approve the current head's dependency and exec trust model.

options.title: Move Vault out of core
options.body: Close or redirect this implementation to a ClawHub/plugin distribution if maintainers do not want Vault owned by the core bundle.

options.title: Pause for security redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a different resolver or credential-handling design before mechanical repair continues.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled Vault after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the PR as the bundled reference implementation, require the three mechanical fixes, then have maintainer/security approve the current head's dependency and exec trust model.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent secrets/docs ownership and dependency/security approver context make this the best available decision route from the inspected history.
